hotspots.label: Myth: bulk index every run; it is simpler.
hotspots.detail: Bulk indexing replaces the document list. Anything missing from the run is deleted. Use it for full runs that you have proven complete.

hotspots.label: Myth: titles and URLs make fine IDs.
hotspots.detail: They change on rename. The new ID is a new document, and the old one is removed as stale.

hotspots.label: Myth: flattening groups into users is safer.
hotspots.detail: Do not flatten groups into user lists. Map groups directly, and consider roles a type of group.

hotspots.label: Myth: the source checks access on click, so ACLs can be loose.
hotspots.detail: Retrieved snippets are passed to the model before anyone clicks. The source check at click time comes too late.
